sunrise.options.server_stick.tooltip: How the stick moves on a server. Java moves only by its keys, so a server's anticheat may pull you back for the stick's own speed and angle. Analog: as you push it (servers that do not check). Free Direction: any angle at full speed, by turning the look the server sees (others see your head follow; it turns back to your view for every hit, use and block). D-pad: arrows on screen in the stick's place (a controller's stick takes the nearest of their eight directions), at full speed. A server you picked a mode for when it pulled you back keeps that one; change this while playing there to change it.
sunrise.options.stick_prompt.tooltip: When a server keeps pulling you back while the stick moves you, ask how the stick should move there.
starling.stick_prompt.title: This Server Pulls You Back
starling.stick_prompt.body: Its anticheat (Grim or one like it) takes only the moves Java's keys make, and the stick's own speed and angle are not one of them. Pick how the stick moves here; Options > Controls > Controller Settings changes it any time.
